lessons: Expert CRITICAL fixed: generate_bundle.py's FFMPEG_VIDEO_TEMPLATE emitted the exact subtitles= burn-in the skill's own text calls broken for Hebrew (no shaping). Template now emits :shaping=complex with an inline build-check + ASS-fallback comment.

Expert CRITICAL fixed: force_style is a subtitles-filter option ONLY (verified in libavfilter/vf_subtitles.c: it sits in subtitles_options, not ass_options), so the previously-recommended switch to the ass filter silently dropped FontName=Heebo and every other style. Both files now say so and instruct editing the .ass [V4+ Styles] Style line.

Expert CRITICAL fixed: select_top_non_overlapping compared start-to-start only, so two 90s windows 60s apart overlapped by 30s while the Troubleshooting section prescribed that same check as the cure. Predicate now tests end-to-start separation in both directions.
Expert CRITICAL fixed: SKILL_HE.md Example 2 claimed --mode is auto-detected from the input; it is not (argparse default is audio). Added check_mode_matches_media() to warn on either mismatch.

REVERSAL worth remembering: both the FFmpeg online docs AND the expert reviewer state that only the ass filter exposes `shaping`. FFmpeg source disproves it: shaping was exposed on the subtitles filter on 2026-06-23. The Judge caught that the reversal was applied in the body but left stale in four other places. Verify filter options against libavfilter source, never against ffmpeg.org's rendered docs.

Root fix this cycle: the skill's headline Hebrew-readiness test (`ffmpeg -version | grep -E 'libass|fribidi|harfbuzz'`) was wrong. --enable-libfribidi/--enable-libharfbuzz are drawtext-filter flags; a working Hebrew build shows neither, and the tap the skill recommends does not pass libfribidi at all. Replaced with `ffmpeg -filters | grep ' subtitles '` plus `brew info libass`.

ElevenLabs Scribe support was advertised but broken: Scribe returns language_code + words[], never segments[]. score_segments.py now normalises Scribe word output into pseudo-segments on spacing gaps.
Examples 1 and 2 documented CLI flags (--transcript, --out, --video) that generate_bundle.py has never implemented; running them verbatim errors out. Corrected to the real argparse surface.

TikTok's only published caption limit is 2,200 UTF-16 runes (Content Posting API). The 4,000 figure the skill carried as 'verified' appears on no TikTok-owned page. LinkedIn publishes no article ceiling; the 100,000 figure was removed rather than replaced.

Deferred MAJOR (next cycle): no 9:16 reframing chain for the Reels/TikTok clip outputs the skill advertises, and the subtitle overlay must come after the scale in the filter chain. Biggest remaining practical gap.
Deferred MAJOR (next cycle): Step B3.5 documents two-pass loudnorm but generate_bundle.py's templates still emit no -af loudnorm, so the emitted scripts do not implement the section's own advice.

Deferred MINOR (next cycle): build_windows() breaks at the first window reaching min_sec, pinning clip length near the 30s floor and contradicting Step B1's stated 45-75s preference. Also YouTube chapters (a fourth chapter dialect) and ID3v2.3 chapter-writing tooling remain uncovered.
Deferred MINOR: the -vf filtergraph interpolates the SRT path raw, so an output directory containing a space or colon breaks it.

Fixed broken macOS FFmpeg install commands: `--with-libass` no longer exists in Homebrew and errors out; promoted homebrew-core `brew install ffmpeg-full` (bundles libass+HarfBuzz, FriBidi transitively) as primary, and corrected the mislabel of ffmpeg-full as a 'community tap' (it is homebrew-core). Fixed `brew install font-heebo` -> `brew install --cask font-heebo`. The core premise (default `brew install ffmpeg` lacks libass) was independently re-verified TRUE.

Expert CRITICAL fixed: this cycle initially promoted `brew install ffmpeg-full` as primary, but ffmpeg-full is KEG-ONLY (not symlinked to PATH), so bare `ffmpeg` (called by every script template) would not resolve to the libass build. Demoted ffmpeg-full to alternative with the full-path caveat; made the homebrew-ffmpeg tap (which links `ffmpeg`) the primary macOS path.

Expert MAJORs fixed: added a python-bidi pre-shape Troubleshooting entry for libass+SRT BiDi mis-ordering that persists on macOS even with FriBidi (cross-ref video-use-best-practices); added a multi-word-FontName fontconfig caveat (check `fc-list | grep -i hebrew` for `Open Sans Hebrew`).

Re-verified accurate (no change): Spotify chapter rules (min 3, first at 00:00, 30s gap, 40-char title), Podcasting 2.0 Chapters JSON v1.2.0, social caption limits (IG 2200/TikTok 4000/X 280+25000/LinkedIn 3000+100000), Apple transcript languages still exclude Hebrew, FFmpeg -ss/-to and subtitles force_style syntax.

Deferred MINOR (revisit next cycle): optionally document python-bidi SRT pre-shaping as a fallback for libass builds that still mis-order Hebrew (cross-ref video-use-best-practices); add a '(verified 2026-05)' marker on the Apple transcript-language list since Apple has expanded it before.
